question: What ignorance invalidates the performance of element-purification by a practitioner?
premises: That person does so without knowing the ancient one
Ignorance is emphasized in the description
inference: Performing element-purification without knowing the ancient source is flawed
uncertainties: The fused token purātanīmavijñāya appears irregular and may contain dittography with avijñāya
plain_english: Whoever performs element-purification without knowing the ancient one, without knowing.
